Name: ShoreLink AB

Name: Baltic Rail
Company description: Baltic Rail is a container-train operator owned by the Rail World Group. We run freight services in the Baltic Adriatic Corridor – an intermodal land bridge within the TEN-T Corridors. It connects Scandinavia and Nordic Europe with the Mediterranean, North Africa and Gulf Regions. Being both wholly-owned subsidiaries of Rail World, Baltic Rail works very closely with its sister company Rail Polska, a private railway operator in Poland.  We serve markets from railway offices in 4 countries of Estonia, Poland, Hungary, Ukraine, and agent offices in Slovenia. Baltic Rail manages container terminals in Poland - Wroclaw Olesnica and Katowice Wlosienica, in Hungary - Szekesfehervar, and provides services at the Terminal Paskov in Czech Republic.

Name: SilSteve JSC
Company description: SILSTEVE: A Leading Multifunctional Terminal at the Port of Sillamäe SILSTEVE operates as a highly versatile terminal in the Port of Sillamäe, the easternmost EU port on the Baltic Sea. Strategically located near major 1520 mm railway lines and highways, the port is only 25 km from the European Union-CIS border. As a modern deep-sea port, Sillamäe is accessible year-round and is rapidly developing as a premier logistics hub. Key Services Provided by SILSTEVE: *Loading and discharging of bulk, general, Ro-Ro, project cargo, and containers transported by sea, road, and rail *Comprehensive storage options with over 110 hectares of open storage and 80,000 m² of covered warehousing *Customs and shipping documentation assistance *Freight forwarding solutions *Cargo packing, sorting, marking, and a range of value-added services Located within a Type 1 Free Zone, the Port of Sillamäe allows for VAT-free transfer of goods ownership and enables tax-exempt transit storage of cargo. Additionally, SILSTEVE operates customs warehouses and a customs terminal outside the free zone, providing flexibility for a range of logistics needs. As a member of the Estonian Chamber of Commerce and Industry and the Estonian Logistics and Freight Forwarding Association, SILSTEVE holds Authorised Economic Operator (AEO) status, ensuring high standards of compliance, security, and efficiency.
